title: Bramble
summary: Col's brown cow, Bramble, was taken off the Greyholt road while he watered the horse. Three of Old Skarn's stragglers have her by their fire on the river above the Thornwick bridge. Col wants them gone, and the bell off her collar back.

steps.journal: Go to the Spit, the goblins' fire on the river's east bank above the Thornwick bridge, and put the three round it down.

ready: The Spit is quiet, and the bell was in the ashes. Take it back to Col in Thornwick's square.
done: Col took the bell and didn't ring it. More goblins will come for the smell; the bell, at least, is home.
